blind.B1: The series is a selected-line study (high-runner line 7 vs control line 1, generation 66), not an exercise intervention: all mice had 6 days of wheel access before sampling (S2.1.p1-p3). It can be analyzed only as an associational, wheel-running-selection question. The Hi (Selected) samples carry the factor: 4 Ce + 3 St (15 samples, one StHi outlier removed, S2.2.p1).
blind.B2: 2x2 line x region: CeCo 4, CeHi 4, StCo 4, StHi 3 (S2.1.p1, S2.2.p1). Contrasts: CeHi-CeCo, StHi-StCo, line-by-region interaction, StHi-CeHi, main effect of line, main effect of region (S2.2.p2).
blind.B3: Probably yes: S2.2.p1 and S2.1.p4 describe samples from individual mouse and brain region (16 samples = 8 mice x 2 regions), so Ce and St likely come from the same animal. The paper does not state the pairing. Candidate key in packet A: title suffix (0-3) within line, pairing 7 animals once in each region; expression check same-key r 0.249 vs -0.036, permutation p 0.001 (supported).
blind.B4: One joint edgeR model: 'A linear model including the main effects of activity line, brain region, and the interaction' (S2.2.p2), quasi-likelihood F-test, no animal term.
blind.B5: 'FDR-adjusted P-value < 0.05' for interaction genes, 86 genes (S3.2.p1); extended list 334 genes at raw P < 0.005; Table 1 display filter FDR < 0.01 and |log2FC| > 1.25; no fold-change cutoff in the DEG definition.

checks.evidence: Run labelled associational selected-line vs control (S2.1.p3, S4.p3; study caveats).
Cells 4/4/4/3 match S2.2.p1; the StHi PCA outlier exclusion is named with its reason (alignment, ownership gates).

Run reports Hi vs Co and records that the paper's Table 1 headers (CeCo-CeHi) conflict with the paper's text; Table 5 log2(Co/Hi) agrees in sign with the data. Recorded in discrepancies; interpretation of Table 1 as paper inconsistency is plausible but not verifiable here.

covariance gate: 'not modelled: no animal ID in GEO'. Packet A lists a key (title suffix across region) linking 14/15 samples, 7 keys once in each level, zero duplicates, and pairing_check says supported (permutation p 0.001). S2.2.p1 speaks of 16 individual mouse samples (8 mice x 2 regions). The 'no animal ID' reason came from a narrow search. Region main effect and the line-by-region interaction (the paper's headline 86 genes, ours 75) are affected by unmodelled repeated measures.
checks.fix: Keep the primary (paper-faithful, unblocked) record; add a labelled sensitivity execution with animal = title suffix within line (e.g. ~ line*region + animal, or duplicateCorrelation-style block on suffix within line), 7 pairs plus the unpaired CeHi_3 sample; state in the record that pairing is an assumption supported by the data and by S2.2.p1 but not stated by the authors; replace 'no animal ID' with 'animal ID not deposited; candidate key title suffix'; ask the authors or check S1 File to confirm.

checks.evidence: Joint ~ line*region edgeR QL, as S2.2.p2.

Region crossed with line; one male sex, same age. Line is a single selected line vs a single control line (lines 7 and 1), so line is aliased with that line's genetic drift; caveat only partly says this ('genetic selection plus running amount').
checks.fix: Add a note that only one replicate line per arm is available, so line effect includes line-specific drift.

checks.evidence: File labelled FPKM, shown to be Cuffnorm size-scaled counts (column sums 38-44M, quantized values); paper uses the same input with TMM in edgeR; 15,213 genes after filter equals the paper; frac_p_gt_0.9 0.09 is not piled up.
padj < 0.05, no fold-change cutoff, as S3.2.p1; raw P < 0.005 recorded as audit rule matching Table A (349 vs 334).
75 vs 86 interaction genes at the same FDR 0.05 rule, disclosed; within-region counts and line main effect correctly marked as not comparable (different rules). HANDBACK does not overclaim.
No stop or refusal; the narrow 'no animal ID' claim is reported under pairing.

human_items: Policy: whether a selectively bred high-runner line vs control line (both wheel-exposed) counts as an exercise study; the run labels it associational.
Whether the primary should be paired when the paper's own model is unpaired (joint vs paper-faithful) is for the person to decide; the sensitivity run is requested.
summary: 该分析忠实复现了论文的 edgeR 联合模型、阈值和样本数,并正确标注为选育品系的关联性比较。主要问题是:同一只小鼠的小脑和纹状体很可能是配对样本(标题后缀可唯一配对 7 只,表达相关检验支持,p=0.001),但记录以“GEO 无动物 ID”为由未处理,应补做一个标注为假设的配对敏感性分析。
